Volume 36: Enter the Galactic Bomb is the thirty-sixth volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the seventh volume in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

In VIZ Media's translation, this volume is published as volume seven of a separately numbered series, "Pokémon Adventures: Diamond and Pearl/Platinum".
plainText:
Volume 36: Enter the Galactic Bomb is the thirty-sixth volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the seventh volume in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

In VIZ Media's translation, this volume is published as volume seven of a separately numbered series, "Pokémon Adventures: Diamond and Pearl/Platinum".

==Blurb==
Team Galactic commanders Jupiter, Mars and Saturn are determined to bomb Lake Verity, Lake Valor and Lake Acuity to awaken the Legendary Lake Pokémon that dwell in their depths! Diamond, Pearl and Platinum divide forces to stop them—but can they conquer?

Then, when things go awry, it’s...Diamond to the rescue?!

Plus, meet Abomasnow, Tangrowth, Buizel, Gastrodon, Purugly, Staravia, and Luxray!

==Publications==
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Chapters==
Chapter 395 - Stopping Sableye
Chapter 396 - Getting Past Gastrodon
Chapter 397 - Outwitting Octillery
Chapter 398 - Tackling Tangrowth
Chapter 399 - Mixing It Up with Machamp
Chapter 400 - Bogging Down Quagsire
Chapter 401 - Besting Buizel I
Chapter 402 - Besting Buizel II
Chapter 403 - Cleaning Up Grimer
Chapter 404 - Encountering Elekid

==Important events==
 
, Candice, and Maylene battle Jupiter at Lake Acuity.
battles Mars at Lake Verity.
battles Saturn at Lake Valor.
The Galactic bomb is detonated over Lake Valor.
The Lake guardians are captured by Team Galactic.
Cyrus crafts one Red Chain.

==Party changes==
===Additions===
Pearl's , "Zeller" in PS402.
Pearl's , "Digler" in PS402.
Pearl's , "Tauler" in PS402.

===Evolutions===
No Pokémon evolve in this volume.

==Gym battles==
Platinum doesn't challenge any Gym Leaders.

==Trivia==
This is the only volume of the Diamond & Pearl chapter where didn't defeat a Gym Leader in any of its chapters.
